violated_contract: A retry limit must bound the complete connection lifetime, including callback-triggered re-entry. A local three-attempt loop in update_conn_params did not bound calls from each high-interval parameter update, so a central that kept granting a high interval could cause requests indefinitely and sleep in the Bluetooth RX callback.
canonical_prevention: Charge every explicit API call, including immediate failures and callback-driven requests, to one per-connection budget. Reset only at connection lifecycle boundaries, never on a favorable intermediate result. Keep callback retries nonblocking and test repeated central refusal, API failures, and same-slot reconnects against the production callback and request bodies.
